basic_info.description: This spacious and bright 550 sq ft studio condo features a beautiful view, a private balcony, secure parking, secure storage, new carpet, fresh paint, plus inclusive heat and hot water. There is a large laundry room on the lower level. The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day by a concierge who will gladly assist you and your guests and manage your packages and deliveries. There are 38 cameras around the exterior premises and are monitored at the front desk.     Located at the top of Cathedral Hill, this sparkling city home greets you with stunning views from a wall of windows which opens to the generous private balcony. Centrally located close to shopping and many dining options on Polk St, the Japan Center, Pacific Heights, the Marina and Russian Hill. It is close to downtown, several medical centers, with direct access to the Peninsula and Marin.     The efficient kitchen features a new stove, multiple cabinets, a refrigerator, and a kitchen island with storage. There is a guest closet plus a large walk-in closet. The bathroom features newly glazed tile and tub. Virtual staging shows various ways to arrange furniture. A leased parking space in the secure garage is available.
